cases.review_basis: Separate direct ZIP enumeration, before production modeling, cross-checked against retained12-context/72-instance raw lifecycle research. Per-instance spawn-to-first-positive-overkill arithmetic is an observed event bound, not lifetime, physical attackability, duty or opportunity. Missing12 endpoints remain unknown; same-time damage is unordered and overlapping summon groups remain separate.
